# `tag-description-changed`

Tag description changed

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `docs` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `tag-description-changed` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M5) |
| **Group** | Docs (annotations only) ([RULES.md section 10](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A tag's description changed.

## Why this default

Documentation only.

## Example

From test case [`tag-description-changed`](../../test/cases/tag-description-changed/): A tag's description changed.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
  tags:
  - name: pets
-   description: Pets
+   description: Everything about pets
  paths:
    '/pets':
```

Findings:

- `tag-description-changed` · info · document

## Test cases

The example above is the only test case for this rule.
